objective: Derive exact weakest sufficient residual proof obligations from the leaves of independently verified finite implication graphs, so terminal work is scheduled against irreducible missing antecedents rather than coarse predeclared certificate names.

semantic_contract.inputs: Explicit finite targets, baseline facts, and independently verified Horn implication edges with receipts.
semantic_contract.primitive_residual_definition: An unresolved atom referenced by the verified graph that has no verified producer and is not already in baseline closure.
semantic_contract.target_output: All exact minimum-cardinality primitive residual sets sufficient to derive the target through the verified graph.
semantic_contract.joint_output: Exact minimum-cardinality primitive residual sets sufficient to derive all supplied targets jointly.
semantic_contract.shared_output: Exact quotient of targets whose minimum residual alternatives are identical.

intended_live_use: Run on the independently verified matched-scope target-specific subfrontier and other finite verified implication cones before any new matched-scope reality acquisition. Feed synthesized residual facts into existing minimum-terminal-basis and fixed-point machinery; do not replace their authority.
